notes.title: pre-alpha 0.3.6: potion poison and the last major piece of UI
notes.content: [h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646196/6a75e1e9dcb0e3e7bdb60be2b0b0c1e4e5d8440e.gif"][/img][/h2][h2]Gameplay[/h2][list][*][p]reworked blocking damage calc. instead of mitigating full damage, it now halves the incoming damage, applies defense mitigation, then has a min damage taken of 0 (vs. 1 on most other calcs). triggering blocking also means not triggering crit[/p][/*][*][p]implemented potion poisoning. hp potions have a 1x accumulation rate and mp potions have a 1.5x rate. the accumulation rate is reduced by poison res with some non-100% efficiency. belt items now also commonly have a 0.6x potion cooldown modifier[/p][/*][*][p]auto attacks (melee and ranged) can now have mp regen recovery set to instant by progressing the combat mastery node and the ranger root node[/p][/*][*][p]added a unique bow, cheat code "rainmaker"[/p][/*][/list][h2]UI[/h2][list][*][p]buff ui rework: hud player, mob, and boss buff bars now shows icons, progress (time remaining), and stack numbers[/p][/*][/list][h2]Dungeon[/h2][list][*][p]stone wall 3rd floor rooms reworked, including a proper boss room layout[/p][/*][/list][h2]Improvements and Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]improved spell timing consistency. ticks now measure exactly between spell cast and end points, making effects like dashes always travel the same distance[/p][/*][*][p]handled regressions due to spell timing migration. some spells may still be slightly broken — for example, raise (summon) could tick multiple times and summon extra mobs[/p][/*][*][p]fixed melee mobs not stopping chase even when they could already attack[/p][/*][*][p]fixed ui opened by world interaction closing themselves too eagerly[/p][/*][*][p]fixed a noticeable lag spike caused by inefficiency in the character stats ui. turned out to be just a typo (also didn’t help that the stats ui preloads on game start...)[/p][/*][/list][h2]Planned for Next Patch[/h2][list][*][p]knight summoner dungeon boss[/p][/*][*][p]dungeon proper ending (level next dungeon ticket drops)[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: pre-alpha 0.3.5: walls, resources, lost & found
notes.content: [h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646196/76cf3c38d849e15045578eade9dc70ffc78c890b.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646196/7e0fcf037f07ae7898dffcf87baffb4a53750dd0.gif"][/img]Spell[/h2][list][*][p]reworked ice shard spell into ice bullet. now it is a channel spell that constantly shoots bullets of ice[/p][/*][/list][h2]UI[/h2][list][*][p]full localization for status modifiers (i.e. skill node & equipment effects), and other localization improvements[/p][/*][*][p]skill node and spell hover tooltips aligned to item tooltip style[/p][/*][*][p]reworked skill node and spell tooltip content[/p][/*][/list][h2]Player Stats[/h2][list][*][p]rescaled carry weights to more closely represent real-life kg values[/p][/*][*][p]rescaled max mana from 5 to 100, as well as mana regen, mana recovery, and spell costs[/p][/*][*][p]added mana drain on channel spells[/p][/*][/list][h2]Inventory[/h2][list][*][p]added 3 hp/mana regen-related uniques[/p][/*][*][p]added the lost & found fishman npc & interact point: drops starting loadout if you lost them, and allows cheat code entry to get unique/rare items[/p][/*][/list][h2]Dungeon[/h2][list][*][p]wall colliders for dungeon rooms[/p][/*][*][p]slowed down the ember caster mobs[/p][/*][/list][h2]Planned for Next Patch[/h2][list][*][p]more dungeon room types and decorations[/p][/*][*][p]knight summoner dungeon boss[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: pre-alpha 0.3.4: mobility spells & the archer tree
notes.content: [h2]UI Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed quick slot picker registering the wrong position.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed quick slot keybind hint text not updating to effective rebind.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed chat scroll not being interactive.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Job Trees & Spells[/h2][list][*][p]Multiple Samurai spell improvements.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Ranger (Archer) tree, bow weapon & weapon set, and ranged attack spell.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Dash & Roll spells.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Animation[/h2][list][*][p]Added visual distinctions between combat and out-of-combat idle and run animations for the player character, on every weapon set.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Notable Known Issue[/h2][list][*][p]Spells on Q slot will not channel.[b]Workaround:[/b] Turn off [i]"Interact casts 1st spell"[/i] or put channel spells on another slot.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Planned for Next Patch[/h2][list][*][p]Wall colliders for dungeon rooms, more dungeon room types, and decorations.[/p][/*][*][p]2 dungeon bosses.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: pre alpha 0.3.3: dungeon doors
notes.content: [h2]dungeon doors[/h2][list][*][p]Door-separated rooms may be helpful to guide pacing in early levels.[/p][/*][*][p]Because the mob spawns inside of corridors were replaced by doors, this also slightly reduces mob amounts.[/p][/*][/list][h2]ux improvement[/h2][list][*][p]New spells learnt will be assigned to empty quick slots automatically.[/p][/*][*][p]Better fine-tuned click volume and colliders for mobs and props.[/p][/*][*][p]Clicking on overlapping objects now gets a predefined priority: items over mobs over other props.[/p][/*][/list][h2]behind the scene & misc.[/h2][list][*][p]Added a few props, dialog, and decorations in the forest camp.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved console command functionalities.[/p][/*][*][p]Uploaded a Mac build.[/p][/*][/list][h2]planned for next patch[/h2][list][*][p]Dash spell, roll spell, archer job tree, bow weapon, etc.[/p][/*][*][p]Wall colliders for dungeon rooms, more dungeon room types and decorations.[/p][/*][*][p]2 dungeon bosses.[/p][/*][/list]
